content.text: Ana Yawe amilmil tunakko, mu
awuk, nu ningo nunguningkiri.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Ana Kaem amilmil tunakko, mu
awuk, nu kaem kawel suen la nunga kiaram ale nu la Biya.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Ana Kari Biya amilmil tunakko, mu
awuk, nu kari bibiya suen la nunga kiaram ale nu la Kari Biya.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Yawe amilmil tunakko. Nu kota
kiwem bibiya duap duap beteso.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Noko ikia te la taiti lilim beteram se aratam.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Nu ali yu guang awote murakoyam muru beteram.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Nu nikim ko melmasak bibiya nunga beteram.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Worem mu woremkalal nikim tuokko.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Sige se baras mu tirom nikim tumonko.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Yawe amilmil tunakko. Nu Egypt
kariimet nunga kuriang gira
bilangara mu nunga moram se kua sapaman.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Nu Egypt alo nunga ningi Israel kariimet nunga giam ale nongorak aratam.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Noko kuting sokel aora biya mu te nunga giam.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Nu gagi biya Red Sea bataguru ilagala awuram.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Ale ko kariimet arungu moke sang te namaram.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Bare Pharaoh ko kager kari karogo mu gagi nunga moa mituwuram.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Yawe amilmil tunakko. Nu ko kariimet
nunga giam ale nu giri giri nongorak
sor merang garagarayam mu ningi aolak ilukaso.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Nu sor saki ko king sokel garagar mu nunga iram se kapaman.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Nu king nunup bibiya nunga moram se kueman.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Sor Amor nunga king Sihon.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Se sor Bashan nunga king Og, mu nunga moram se kueman.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Nu nunga ali sor mu bataguru noko kariimet Israel nungaram.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Se ali umu eng am nungara nunguning ko kariimet nungaram.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Yawe amilmil tunakko. Nu ana ikup
memek biya ningi kapaman bare nago ko gomang batagam.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Nu kager kari memek alo nuguting te nanga bataguru tam.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Nu kariimet se mel suen la inang nungarso.

content: Noko kua nangara mu kumik menara mena.

content.text: Buta se, ana tom suen biya anananga
Kaem duruk wonong te bagoso mu amilmil tui se laganakko.
